subject: QuellMed HQ demo — access needs, escort and NDA coordination
messages:
From: Ava Liao <ava.liao@quellmed.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Tan <sophie.t@quellmed.com>, procurement-quellmed@quellmed.com
Date: 2026-04-21 09:12 PDT
Subject: Requesting HQ demo week of Apr 27 — access requirements?

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. We’d like to bring a small delegation (4 people: product, security, procurement, and our CTO) to Redwood HQ for an in-person demo and short immersion. Preferred week is Apr 27–May 1; ideal slot is Apr 29 in the morning.

A few quick questions to help us plan:
- Do visiting execs from Singapore require any pre-clearance or onsite quarantine protocol at your facility?
- Is there a standard NDA/DocuSign you prefer for visitors who will see a live demo and limited PII examples?
- Any constraints for bringing a small test device (laptop + USB dongle)?

If possible please send a short runbook (arrival, badging, escort) and any dietary/catering intake forms — Sophie on cc will coordinate travel.

Cheers,
Ava
Ava Liao
Head of Product, QuellMed
ava.liao@quellmed.com
+65 9123 4567
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Ava Liao <ava.liao@quellmed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-21 10:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Requesting HQ demo week of Apr 27 — access requirements?

Hi Ava — great to hear and excited to host the QuellMed team. Short answers up front:

- No government quarantine for visitors, but we do require pre-arrival badging and identity docs for non-US/APAC nationals. For Singapore passport holders we'll need a scanned passport and the full legal name as on passport at least 48 hours ahead.
- We have a standard external NDA for visitors; we typically execute via DocuSign. I’ll send the link and also attach the PDF for review.
- Laptops are fine; USB dongles are allowed but must remain in the visitors’ possession. If you plan to connect to any of our internal test networks we’ll need to validate the device and apply a guest ACL — let us know.

Scheduling note: We have a lab room (Lab 3) with dedicated AV that’s ideal for a live model session, but it’s reserved on Apr 29 AM for an internal workshop. Possible alternatives: Apr 29 PM (Lab 3 available), Apr 28 AM (Conference Suite B + portable AV), or Apr 30 AM (Lab 2 with limited capacity).

I’m attaching the floor plan and a short visitor-runbook — see the runbook for parking, badging, and escort details.

Attachments: hq-floorplan_v2.pdf, visitor-runbook-v1.docx, redwood-nda-quellmed-docusign.pdf

Would you like us to hold Apr 29 AM tentatively while we get the NDA and passport info squared away?

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
(415) 555-0124
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-22 08:40 PDT
Subject: Fwd: Requesting HQ demo week of Apr 27 — room conflict on 29 AM

Nikhil — forwarding because Lab 3 is double-booked on Apr 29 AM (we confirmed yesterday). Options: (1) move QuellMed to Apr 29 PM in Lab 3; (2) keep AM and reconfigure Conference Suite B with extra portable GPU rig (limited to a 45-minute live session); (3) offer Apr 30 AM in Lab 2 (less AV but quieter).

Also note: we have a catering blackout on Apr 29 AM due to a private board event on the 10th floor. If they need breakfast service for the delegation that becomes a logistics lift.

If we go with option 2, Marcus can standby with the portable rig and we’ll need to check power/ventilation.

—Kimberly

Date: 2026-04-23 02:15 PDT
Subject: Re: Requesting HQ demo week of Apr 27 — access requirements?

Thanks — very helpful. We’d prefer to keep Apr 29 if possible but can do Apr 29 PM if AM is impossible. Two quick follow-ups:

1) DocuSign: can you send the signer template to Sophie (cc) — procurement will sign.
2) Passport info: Sophie will collect scanned passports and send them to the badging address you provide.
3) Catering: dietary restrictions include one vegetarian and one halal; we usually provide our own small refreshments but would like coffee/tea on-site. Is there any cost to adding a light breakfast during an outside catering blackout?

If Apr 29 PM works, please confirm Lab 3 availability and whether the portable rig option is still on the table if something changes.

On another note, one of our execs requires a visitor letter for visa stamping — is a simple invitation on Redwood letterhead possible?

Best,
Ava
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Ava Liao <ava.liao@quellmed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Sophie Tan <sophie.t@quellmed.com>
Date: 2026-04-25 16:40 PDT
Subject: Re: Requesting HQ demo week of Apr 27 — access requirements?

Ava — thanks, all set. Summary & confirmations below:

- Date/time: Confirmed Apr 29, 2026 — 1:30 PM to 4:00 PM (Lab 3). We held the session for you in the PM to avoid the morning board event.
- NDA: DocuSign template sent (link above). PDF attached for your records (redwood-nda-quellmed-docusign.pdf).
- Passports & badging: Sophie, please send full-name-as-on-passport + passport scan to visitor-badging@redwood.com by Apr 27 12:00 PDT. Badging team will issue temporary access for arrival day; onsite escort will meet at the lobby.
- Visa letter: We can provide an invitation letter on Redwood letterhead. Marcus — can you draft and share the scanned letter by EOD tomorrow?
- Catering: Because of the board blackout, internal catering can’t service the 10th floor in the morning, but for the afternoon session we can arrange individually packaged boxes (vegetarian + halal) and coffee/tea at a $10 per-person fee. Tessa — please handle the catering order and send invoice instructions to procurement-quellmed@quellmed.com.
- Equipment: Marcus will bring the portable GPU rig as backup. If you need any network whitelisting for device access, notify us 24 hours ahead.

Attachments: hq-floorplan_v2.pdf (floor markings for Lab 3), visitor-runbook-v1.docx (arrival checklist).

Looking forward to hosting — I’ll attach the calendar invite once Marcus has the letter ready.

Best regards,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
